problemStatement.formal: Does there exist C > 1 s.t. ∀ ε > 0, N ≥ 1, ∃ ε-almost covering system with all moduli in [N, CN]? Answer: NO (FFKPY). For C ≤ N^{α(N)}, α(N) = logloglog N / 4loglog N, uncovered density ≥ (1-o(1))·∏(1-1/nᵢ).
problemStatement.plain: Can we cover almost all integers using congruences whose moduli are all close together (within factor C)? No: for any fixed C, the coverage cannot approach 100% when moduli are restricted to [N, CN].
whyMatters: Covers the theory of dense covering systems and their limitations — disproved by FFKPY
Connects to sieve theory (Brun, Selberg) and natural density of arithmetic progressions
12 sorries in existing Lean file represent the FFKPY disproof, including 5 Aristotle-ready targets
